plan.title: Explore dataset structure and statistics
plan.description: Write scratch.py to: (1) Load annotations.json and examine structure, (2) Count images, annotations, categories, (3) Compute annotations-per-image distribution, (4) Compute category frequency distribution (how many categories have <5, <10, <20 annotations), (5) Check image sizes, (6) Examine product reference images structure (how many products, what angles), (7) Check overlap between annotation product_codes and available product image folders, (8) Check how many annotations have corrected=true vs false.
plan.success_criteria: Complete statistical summary of the dataset logged, understanding of class imbalance and data availability

plan.title: Baseline: Single-class YOLOv8m detection
plan.hypothesis: A YOLOv8m model trained for single-class detection at image size 1280 can achieve detection_mAP@0.5 > 0.5, giving final_score > 0.35 (since classification will be random/zero)
plan.description: Convert COCO annotations to YOLO format with a single class (product). Create 90/10 train/val split. Train YOLOv8m at imgsz=1280 for 30 epochs with high max_det (300). Evaluate detection mAP@0.5 on val set. For submission, predict all boxes as category_id=0. This establishes our detection baseline.

plan.title: Multi-class YOLOv8m detection (all 329 categories)
plan.hypothesis: Training YOLOv8m with all categories directly achieves both detection and classification, yielding final_score > single-class approach
plan.description: Convert annotations to YOLO format with all 329 categories. Train YOLOv8m at imgsz=1280 for 50 epochs. Evaluate both detection_mAP@0.5 (class-agnostic) and classification_mAP@0.5 (class-aware). Compare final_score with single-class baseline.

plan.title: Scale up: YOLOv8l/x multi-class with tuned hyperparameters
plan.hypothesis: Larger model (YOLOv8l or x) with more epochs and tuned augmentation improves both detection and classification by 5-10%
plan.description: Train YOLOv8l or YOLOv8x with all categories, imgsz=1280, 80 epochs, tuned augmentation (mosaic, scale, mixup). Use cosine LR schedule. Compare with step 3.

plan.title: Confidence threshold and NMS optimization sweep
plan.hypothesis: Sweeping confidence thresholds (0.05-0.5) and NMS IoU (0.3-0.8) on validation set will find a better operating point, improving final_score by 1-3%
plan.description: Load the best trained model from exp-004. Run inference on all validation images (not just 20) with various confidence and NMS threshold combinations. Calculate proper detection_map50 and classification_map50 using full precision-recall curves instead of the simplified single-point metric. Find optimal thresholds.
plan.success_criteria: final_score > 0.79 with optimized thresholds, and we have proper mAP evaluation

plan.title: Train YOLOv8l on full dataset (no val split) with best hyperparameters
plan.hypothesis: Using all 1000 images for training instead of 900 gives the model more data for rare categories, improving classification_map50 and boosting final_score by 1-2%
plan.description: Modify the training pipeline to use ALL 1000 images for training (no validation split). Keep the same YOLOv8l architecture and hyperparameters from exp-004 (80 epochs, imgsz=1280, mixup=0.15, copy_paste=0.3, AdamW, cosine LR). For evaluation, still hold out the same 100 val images but train on all 1000. The submission model trains on all data. Use YOLO's built-in evaluation on the held-out set for comparison metrics.

plan.title: Two-stage: YOLO detector + crop classifier for classification boost
plan.hypothesis: A separate crop classifier trained on GT crops can improve classification_map50 from ~0.71 to 0.80+, boosting final_score since classification is the weaker component (0.71 vs 0.82 detection)
plan.description: Extract product crops from training images using GT bounding boxes. Train a lightweight classifier (EfficientNet-B0 or ResNet-50 via torchvision) on these crops with proper augmentation. At inference: detect with YOLO (class-agnostic or multi-class), crop detections, classify with separate model, use classifier predictions to override/refine YOLO class predictions. Must fit within 300s inference and 420MB model size.

plan.title: YOLOv8l with more epochs and refined augmentation on full dataset
plan.hypothesis: Increasing training from 80 to 120 epochs with refined augmentation (stronger mosaic, more copy_paste) on the full dataset will improve final_score from 0.8498 to 0.87+ as the model has more time to learn rare categories
plan.description: Build on exp-006's full-dataset approach. Increase epochs to 120, tune augmentation parameters (mosaic=1.0, copy_paste=0.5, mixup=0.2), use cosine LR with lower final LR (lrf=0.005), and increase close_mosaic to 15 epochs. Keep same evaluation methodology.

plan.title: Test-time augmentation (TTA) for detection and classification boost
plan.hypothesis: TTA with horizontal flip and multi-scale inference improves both detection and classification mAP by 1-3%
plan.description: Use YOLO's built-in TTA (augment=True in predict) which applies horizontal flip and multi-scale. Test on validation set to measure improvement. If too slow, use only horizontal flip. Apply to best model from step 8 or exp-006.
plan.success_criteria: final_score improvement of at least 1% over non-TTA baseline

plan.title: YOLOv8x model on full dataset for maximum capacity
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x (extra-large) has more capacity to learn the 329 categories, improving classification_map50 which is the weaker component
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x on full dataset with best hyperparameters from previous experiments. Reduce batch size to 4 if needed for memory. Use 80-100 epochs. Compare against YOLOv8l results.

plan.title: Final optimization: ensemble or best single model with optimized inference
plan.hypothesis: Combining best detection model with optimized confidence thresholds and optional TTA maximizes final_score
plan.description: Take the best performing model from steps 8-10. Fine-tune confidence threshold on validation set (simple sweep of 5-10 values). Combine with TTA if it helped. Ensure model weights < 420MB and inference < 300s. Create clean final main.py.
plan.success_criteria: Highest achievable final_score with all optimizations combined
